gpuDevice.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Max, Unspecified Version)

settings.cpuTiming: performance.now; no scheduler yields inside compute

worker.timingNote: wall includes messaging; computation includes the worker cooperative scheduler; local core has no scheduler yields

cancellationProbe.timingNote: Latency ratios and bounds use this worker's three measured full/short jobs; no fixed millisecond limit is an acceptance criterion. A late signal makes the trial inconclusive, not evidence of cancellation failure.

rings.qualityNote: Original JS uses adaptive-density continuous rings and original assembly; WASM uses segmented 1.5-density rings. Cross-renderer pixels are informational.

temporal.qualityNote: Within-renderer reset is a correctness check; cross-renderer temporal pixels are informational.

animationFps.note: Serial ABBA, warmed caches retained. JS computes its camera and RenderView; WASM render_frame(mode=1) computes camera, cache and draw dispatch entirely in Rust. CPU frame time includes camera/planning/WebGL submission and excludes GPU completion/rAF wait. Both benchmark drivers run on the same thread; production WASM uses an OffscreenCanvas worker. Guided cache policies differ; FPS is refresh-rate limited.
